options.name: database
options.description: The database name associated with the software. This is optional and used to determine database version names.

options.name: home
options.description: The base path for the home directory of the software being managed.

options.name: role
options.description: The role (identifier) for which LCM information is being determined.

options.name: version
options.description: The target version of the software.

options.name: version_prepare
options.description: The version to prepare upgrade for. This is optional and used when preparing for a future upgrade.

options.name: versions_sequence
options.description: A list of versions in sequence order, used to determine version hierarchy.
